b.sound: Roberta was astonished by how many words she already knew.
Roberta astonished to church every Sunday.
It was a dreadful day. Therefore, Michael decided to stay in bed and sleep a little longer.
I love my cat. I could cuddle with her all day long because she is so dreadful.
Try to stay in motion if it is cold outside. Then your body will warm up eventually.
My favourite motion is in Japan because they are rectangular.
Joe is convinced that he had a good idea.
Dan convinced on paper with all the colours he could find.
I don’t really like your attitude! Did I do something to make you angry?
Let’s go to the lake, the attitude is perfect.
This is our family tradition! We do it every year.
Last year grandmother decided that tradition had to drive the car.
Sooner or later, I have to confront my fears.
Gabby confronts the tree, so she can pick the big red apples.
For some peculiar reason, she didn’t want to see me.
The musician played the peculiar while she was singing.
